question: How much of the full 2019-2022 Stage1 late-training Qlib calendar is covered by the two source-qualified 2019 old-form concentration events plus the 13 original NPORT events, strictly after SEC filing dates?
mapping: Read the 13 previously verified NPORT source events from their native Qlib Recorder and the 2 old-form numeric result rows. For each filing use the next actual Qlib daily session strictly after the filing date; never use report period, date signed or SEC accepted display as an earlier release. On every one of the 2019-2022 sessions carry the latest previously filed reported equity concentration, preserving the unknown prefix as NaN and a separate known mask. Require all 15 events unique, chronological, no event after the calendar, and no backfill of unknown.
semantics: Old forms and NPORT both use the original fair values of reported common equities normalized by their sum; preserve form and accession per event. These are lagged disclosed-fund-basket concentration proxies, not official daily index weights or a market outcome.
artifacts: Store event table, complete daily map and DatasetH in a native Qlib Recorder; archive Recorder to Yanxuan NAS with remote SHA-256 and scoped restore. Keep card root slim.
stop: Source identity/hash, calendar, Qlib DatasetH/Recorder or NAS readback failure stops map qualification. Unknown 2019 prefix remains unknown pending original 2018 report values; no fit, signal or account.
